items.title: Dorothy Tait Interview, 1968-12-21
items.q: when was the first time you—you had, uh, Joel Schultz's band play? Do you remember?

ctx.x: In New Orleans. All right, Bob. Now, uh, when was the first time you—you had, uh, Joel Schultz's band play? Do you remember?

Yes, I think it was January 62. I had been in Washington and just decided to go with the government. Had a few days, came down here, uh, and was wandering on the street and past Preservation Hall, which I had not even heard of up until that date. And, uh, was with a friend, and I said, my God, that sounds like George Lewis. And I sort of blindly pushed in past Sandy, past the basket, didn't stop, opened the door, and I said, my God, it is George Lewis. And, uh, I hadn't heard him play since, I think it was 1946…
